summary: Catalyst Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its IPO units (CATLU) may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares (CATL) and rights (CATLR) beginning September 17, 2026. Each unit comprises one Class A share and one right to receive one-seventh of a share upon consummation of an initial business combination; no fractional rights will trade. Unseparated units continue trading as CATLU. Separation requires broker contact with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust. No business combination, target, price, premium, or advisor was disclosed; watch for deal announcement and redemption dynamics.
